Docs.Content:
The ordinances embraced in this and the following titles and sections shall together constitute and be designated "The General Code of the City of Birmingham, Alabama," and may be so cited. This Code may also be cited as the "General City Code" or, for the purpose of prosecutions in the municipal court, as "GCC."

(Code 1980, § 1-1-1)

Docs.Title: Sec. 1-1-2. - Definitions and rules of construction.
Docs.Content:
In the construction of this Code and of all other city ordinances, the following definitions and rules shall be observed, unless the context clearly requires otherwise:

Acts. References to acts are to acts of the Alabama Legislature, as published in the Acts of Alabama. Acts passed after 1978 are referenced to the act number, which number includes the last two digits of the year of enactment. All other acts are referenced to act number and year of enactment. All references to acts are followed by a parenthetical reference to the page number in the Acts of Alabama upon which the act begins. The page number reference is for information purposes only. All references to acts are to such acts as amended.

Alley. The term "alley" means any roadway or public way dedicated to public use and designed for use as a means of gaining access to and securing egress from the rear of premises, and 20 feet or less in width, unless otherwise officially designated as a street.

Authorized emergency vehicle. The term "authorized emergency vehicle" means any vehicle of the fire and police departments of the city.

Avenue. The term "avenue" means a street designated by ordinance as an avenue.

Board of adjustment (zoning). The term "zoning board of adjustment" includes the board of adjustment of the city and any officer or agent of that board authorized to act for and on behalf of the board with respect to the enforcement and administration of any ordinance.

Board of health. The term "board of health" means the county board of health.

Bond. When a bond is required, an undertaking in writing shall be required.

Business district. The term "business district" means the territory contiguous to a street when 50 percent or more of the frontage thereon for a distance of 300 feet or more is occupied by buildings in use for business purposes.

City. The term "city" means the City of Birmingham in the Counties of Jefferson and Shelby in the State of Alabama.

Computation of time. The time within which an act is to be done shall be computed by excluding the first day and including the last day. However, if the last day is Sunday or a legal holiday, as defined in Code of Ala. 1975, § 1-1-4, or a day on which the office in which the act must be done is closed as permitted by any law of this state, the last day shall also be excluded, and the next succeeding secular or working day shall be counted as the last day within which the act may be done.

Conjunctions/disjunctions. The terms "conjunctions" and "disjunctions means a provision involving two or more items, conditions, provisions or events, which items, conditions, provisions or events are connected by the conjunction "and," "or" or "either … or" the conjunction shall be interpreted as follows:

(1)

"And" indicates that all the connected terms, conditions, provisions or events apply.

(2)

"Or" indicates that the connected terms, conditions, provisions or events apply singly or in any combination.

(3)

"Either … or" indicates that the connected terms, conditions, provisions or events apply singly but not in combination.

Council, city council. The term "council" or "city council" means the Council of the City of Birmingham.

County. The term "the county" means Jefferson County or Shelby County, Alabama.

County personnel board. The term "county personnel board" means the Personnel Board of Jefferson County.

Curb. The term "curb" means the lateral boundary of the roadway of a street marked by curbstone or a substitute of concrete or other material.

Day. The term "day" means a calendar day unless otherwise specified in this Code.

Damages. The term "damages" includes all those elements of recovery as are allowed under the laws of the state in actions for torts.

Delegation of authority. Wherever a provision appears requiring the head of a department or some other city officer to do some act or perform some duty, it shall be construed to authorize the head of the department or other officer to designate, delegate, and authorize subordinates to perform the required act or perform the duty, unless the terms of the provision or section specify otherwise. Therefore, the definition of the term "city officer" or "employee" shall be construed to include the duly authorized representative of the officer or employee.

Directions.

(1)

The term "generally north and south direction" means a direction deviating to either the right or left from a true north and south line 45 degrees or less.

(2)

The term "generally east and west direction" means a direction deviating to either the right or left from a true east and west line less than 45 degrees.

Garbage. The term "garbage" means waste matter of animal or vegetable origin or nature.

Gender. Words used in the masculine gender shall include the feminine and neuter.

Health department, county health department or board of health. The term "health department," "county health department" or "board of health" includes the Jefferson County Health Department or board of health and any officer or agent of the department or board authorized to act for and on behalf of the department or board with respect to the enforcement and administration of this Code and other city ordinances. The term "health department," "county health department" or "board of health" shall also include the Shelby County Health Department and its officers or agents authorized to act for and on behalf of the department or board of health with respect to the enforcement and administration of this Code and other city ordinances.

Health officer. The term "health officer" means the county health officer or authorized assistants.

In the city or within the city. The term "in the city" or "within the city" means within the corporate limits of the city and the police jurisdiction thereof, except as otherwise provided.

Joint authority. All words giving joint authority to three or more persons or officers give such authority to a majority of such persons or officers, unless it is otherwise declared.

Loop area, loop or downtown section. The term "loop area," "loop" or "downtown section" means the portion of the city bounded on the north by the north line of 8th Avenue, North, on the east by the east line of 24th Street, on the south by the south line of Morris Avenue, and on the west by the west line of 17th Street.

May. The term "may" is permissive.

Mayor. The term "mayor" means the mayor of the City of Birmingham.

Month. The term "month" shall be a calendar month.

Number. Words used in the singular include the plural and the plural includes the singular number.

Oath. The term "oath" shall be construed to include an affirmation in all cases in which, by law, an affirmation may be substituted for an oath, and in such cases the terms "swear" and "sworn" shall be equivalent to the terms "affirm" and "affirmed."

Officer, department or agency. Designation of an officer, department, or agency, without qualifying words, shall refer to such officer or agency of the city.

Owner. The term "owner," applied to a building or land, includes any part owner, joint owner, tenant in common, joint tenant, or tenant by the entirety, of the whole or of a part of such building or land.

Person. The term "person" includes a corporation, firm, partnership, association, organization or any other group acting as a unit, as well as a human being.

Personal property. The term "personal property" includes every species of property except real property, as herein defined.

Police jurisdiction. The term "police jurisdiction" means the territory outside but within three miles of the corporate limits of the city, but this term does not include territory within the corporate limits of any other incorporated municipality.

Preceding, following. The terms "preceding" and "following" mean next before and next after, respectively.

Property. The term "property" includes real and personal property.

Real property. The term "real property" includes lands, tenements and hereditaments.

Residence district. The term "real property" means the territory contiguous to a street not comprising a business district when the frontage on that street for a distance of 300 feet or more is mainly occupied by dwellings or by dwellings and buildings in use for residential purposes.

Roadway. The term "roadway" means the portion of a street between the regularly established curblines, or that part of a street devoted to vehicular traffic.

Secular day. The term "secular day" means a day other than Sunday or Christmas Day.

Shall. The term "shall" is mandatory.

Sidewalk. The term "sidewalk" means that portion of a street between the curbline and adjacent property line.

Signature or subscription. The term "signature" or "subscription" includes a mark when the person cannot write.

State. The term "state" means the State of Alabama.

Street. The term "street" means and includes any public way, road, highway, street, avenue, boulevard, bridge, viaduct, trestle and the approaches to any bridge, viaduct or trestle within the city or its police jurisdiction but shall not include an alley, as defined in this section.

Time. Words used in the past or present tense include the future as well as past and present.

Traffic officer. The term "traffic officer" means any officer designated by the mayor or the chief of police to direct or control traffic upon the streets of the city, or any member of the police department.

Writing. The term "writing" or "written" shall include typewriting and printing.

Year. The term "year" means a calendar year.

(Code 1980, § 1-1-2)

State Law reference— Similar provisions, Code of Ala. 1975, § 1-1-4.

Docs.Title: Sec. 1-1-3. - Applicability of Code.
Docs.Content:
Every section contained in this Code, whether expressed to apply "within the city" or "in the city," or not so expressed, shall apply and have full force and effect within the corporate limits of the city and within the police jurisdiction thereof and within the territorial limits of any property or right-of-way owned by the city, wheresoever situated; provided, that any such section shall not apply within that police jurisdiction if the violation thereof is expressly exempted from the application of section 1-1-6, or if the same cannot legally be made to apply in that police jurisdiction, or if the same cannot physically apply in that police jurisdiction, or if the same, otherwise than by use of such terms as "in the city" or "within the city," contains clear inherent evidence of intent that it shall not apply in such police jurisdiction.

(Code 1964, § 1-3; Code 1980, § 1-1-3)
